question: Indian Renewable Energy Development Agency (IREDA) has signed a loan agreement with SJVN Green Energy for financing over ₹ 4,000 crores for the 1000 MW solar power project at Bikaner, Rajasthan. Who is the current chairman and managing director of Indian Renewable Energy Development Agency (IREDA) in 2023?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Pradip Kumar Das**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Pradip Kumar Das** is the current chairman and managing director of the **Indian Renewable Energy Development Agency (IREDA) in 2023**.
 
• IREDA is a public limited government company established as a **non-banking financial institution** under the administrative control of the Ministry of New and Renewable Energy (MNRE).
 
• Its primary objective is to promote, develop, and extend financial assistance for renewable energy and energy efficiency/conservation projects.
 
• The agency plays a crucial role in the financing of renewable energy projects in India, thereby contributing significantly to the country's energy transition goals.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Indian Renewable Energy Development Agency (IREDA) was established in **1987 **and has since been pivotal in the financing of renewable energy projects in India.
 
• IREDA offers various financial products and services to support the development of renewable energy projects, including term loans, bridge loans, and debt refinancing.
 
• The agency's mission is to be a pioneering financial institution for the promotion and development of the renewable energy sector and to act as a catalyst for the efficient use of energy.
 
• IREDA's vision is to contribute to the sustainable development of the nation by promoting and financing renewable energy projects and energy efficiency initiatives.
